blocking_findings.finding: Train/validation endpoint purge and minimum origin counts are trusted manifest assertions; not independently recomputed from scanned rows.
Target counts are pooled pre-holdout counts, not per-split counts; common validation origins are not computed and split_status can overstate evidence.
Official-close linkage is a boolean claim without a pinned, structurally validated evidence record.
